quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 44

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for the train to pass before crossing.

questions.question: When entering interstate traffic from an entrance or acceleration ramp, a driver should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Expect other drivers to change lanes for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering from an entrance or acceleration ramp, you must yield to drivers already on the interstate. Merge safely when there is a gap in traffic.

questions.question: You may park or stop on a freeway shoulder:

options.text: As long as you turn on your emergency flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to check a map.

questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except in an emergency.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection, you should:

options.text: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a yellow light, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgment of speed and distance becomes distorted.
You calm down and concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows reaction time, reduces vision, distorts judgment of speed and distance, reduces recovery from headlight glare, and increases risky behavior.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that construction workers may be on or near the road. Slow down and be very careful.

questions.question: A red traffic light means you must:
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection, at the stop line, and before any crosswalk.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, you should:

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before proceeding.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a multi-track crossing, do not move until you have a clear view of all tracks. Another train may be approaching on a different track.

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Watches for the actions of other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches for the actions of other drivers.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches for what other drivers are doing and expects potential problems.

questions.question: A "No standing" sign means:

options.text: You may never stop your vehicle there.
You may park there if the driver stays in the vehicle.
You may stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
You may stop to load or unload merchandise.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
questions.explanation: A "No standing" sign means you can make a brief stop only to pick up or drop off passengers.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for leaving an expressway.
The safest speed for entering an expressway.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for leaving an expressway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for a highway exit. In this example, the speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: You can only pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street if:

options.text: You can see the road clearly ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming cars.
Your vehicle can go fast enough to pass.

questions.explanation: You can only pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street if you can see ahead clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic, and your vehicle can go fast enough to pass. Do not pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: Are safe if held by a strong adult.
Are safe standing on the floor in the back seat.
Will not be hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must always be properly secured in a seat.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must always be properly secured in a seat.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats if they are too small for regular seat belts. No one is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always keep children properly fastened in a seat.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: You may drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public highway:

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road or sidewalk. You cannot have an open alcohol container in any part of the vehicle where the driver or passengers sit.

questions.question: You may cross double solid yellow lines:
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway, enter or exit a road, or make a legal U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from the sides.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe.
Both lanes go in the same direction.
You may pass even if it is dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means drivers in both directions can pass. Only pass if oncoming traffic is not in your way.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs show?

options.text: The fastest and slowest speeds allowed by law.
The speed to drive in heavy traffic.
The speed to drive in poor conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest and slowest speeds allowed by law.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the maximum or minimum speed allowed on that road. Maximum limits are for ideal conditions. Slow down when weather or traffic conditions are bad.

questions.question: You come to a blocked intersection. You should:

options.text: Get as close as possible to the car ahead.
Stay out of the intersection until you can drive through.
Honk your horn to move traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can drive through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if you cannot drive all the way through it. Wait until traffic ahead clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: At night, what is hardest to see?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are harder to see at night than signs and other objects on the road.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
Opposite to the direction of the skid.
In any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle starts to straighten out, turn the steering wheel back the other way.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The bigger the vehicle, the bigger the blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near the rear that cannot be seen in their side or rearview mirrors.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet weather, slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and leave more space between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: You are driving at night toward another vehicle. What should your headlights be set to?
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is approaching or ahead of you. Use the low beam setting to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: Why does driving at night require extra caution?

options.text: There is more traffic at night.
Drivers cannot see as well at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers cannot see as well at night.
questions.explanation: It is dark at night, so drivers cannot see as well as during the day. From 30 minutes after sunset to 30 minutes before sunrise, or when people and vehicles cannot be seen from 500 feet away, you must use your headlights.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means that you cannot make a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is not allowed. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: Which light means you should slow down and proceed with caution at an intersection?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow traffic light means slow down, be careful, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When changing lanes on a highway, you should:

options.text: Check your rearview and outside mirrors.
Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, you should signal first, check your mirrors, and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Do all three steps every time.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel.

questions.question: When making a right turn on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You may turn right on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When turning, you must let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first.

questions.question: You are waiting in a line at a stop sign. The cars ahead have passed through. If there is no other traffic, you:

options.text: May go through without stopping again.
Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
May slowly roll past the stop sign.
May follow the car ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at every stop sign. Check for traffic before proceeding. Do not skip this step, even if other cars are around you.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: Drivers should be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians because:

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians are small and easy to miss. They may also move quickly or have dim lights. Always watch carefully for them to prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: Is texting while driving legal?

options.text: Yes, but it is not recommended.
Yes, but only for drivers without a probationary license.

questions.explanation: In Indiana, drivers cannot use a phone to type or read text messages or emails while driving. The only exception is calling emergency services.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or dangers ahead. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What should you do to avoid getting tired on a long drive?

options.text: Stop to rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Change feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: To avoid fatigue on a long trip, take a break every two hours. If you feel drowsy, pull over safely and take a nap or find a place to sleep.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road slants toward the center. What does this mean?
questions.explanation: A solid line on the road edge marks where the road ends. When the edge line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: At a stop sign with no stop line or crosswalk, when can you proceed?

options.text: After slowing down to check for traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
questions.explanation: Stop completely at every stop sign before entering the intersection. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the most important rule for driving safely on curves?

options.text: Drive at the posted speed limit when entering the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the posted speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle may be hard to control on curves because of inertia. Slow down before entering a curve to keep control of your car.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast in wet conditions. Driving slower reduces the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: You have a green light at an intersection, but pedestrians are crossing against the red light. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrians.
Stop and let the pedestrians cross safely.
Drive close to them to scare them away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrians cross safely.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians, even if you have a green light. Pedestrians may be caught in the intersection. Keep them safe in all situations.
